name: Sarah Waters-Bates
body:
The Hot Club lost one of our own. Paul Bedrosian has been part of the HC family for years. He would always come in early with a huge smile to chat and check in with everyone before DJ’ing. He has been part of the music seen in Providence forever and the impact of his loss will be profound. One of the nicest guys you will have ever met. He loved his Reggae and loved sharing that love with others. 

His last text to me was “Teamwork makes the dream work”. 

Imagine if we all had this mindset. Paul truly lived this everyday!

Providence will miss you Pauly…
